battle.name: 茅茅起義
battle.brief: 茅茅起義是1952年起發生於肯亞、針對英國殖民統治的武裝衝突，英方於同年宣布進入緊急狀態。條目所列線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun）於1850年列裝，屬德系早期野戰火砲類型，年代遠早於本場衝突，並非起義方專用裝備；這項早期裝備只供年代與軍隊體系對照。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun）在德國早期野戰砲兵體系中，主要提供軍隊隨行火力，是地面部隊編制內用於整體火砲支援的裝備之一。

countries: 1952年10月20日，英屬肯尼亞總督菲利普·米切爾宣布緊急狀態，因此這場衝突的一方是英國及其在肯尼亞的殖民保安體系，另一方則是後來被稱為茅茅、並以肯尼亞土地與自由軍（KLA）名義活動的武裝組織。KLA並非一個獲國際承認的國家，而是由分散的宣誓組織、地方戰鬥隊及流動突擊隊構成的鬥爭網絡，主要依托 Mount Kenya 森林、尼耶里與恩布高地以及阿伯代爾山脈，並曾企圖向基安布和維多利亞湖一帶擴張。英方也不是單由英國本土常備軍作戰，而是由肯尼亞警察、王的非洲步槍隊（KAR）、本地募訓的肯尼亞團、國防部情報與特別分支、英軍增援及皇家空軍共同運作。戰線沒有固定前線，也沒有傳統攻城戰；英方控制城鎮、道路、據點和補給線，KLA則以森林掩護部隊、利用道路與孤立警哨之間的空隙活動。這是一場英帝國殖民政府對抗肯尼亞武裝起義的鄉村戰爭，也是肯尼亞獨立運動中最直接的一場軍事衝突。
countriesEn: On 20 October 1952, Kenya's British governor, Philip Mitchell, proclaimed a state of emergency. One belligerent was therefore the British Empire acting through its colonial security system in Kenya; the other was the armed organization later called the Mau Mau and known as the Kenya Land and Freedom Army, or KLA. The KLA was not a diplomatically recognized state but a network of oath-bound groups, local fighting units, and mobile strike teams based mainly in the Mount Kenya forest, the Nyeri and Embu highlands, and the Aberdare range. Some units attempted to extend operations toward Kiambu and the shores of Lake Victoria, but never established a durable western position. The British side was not simply the British Army. It combined the Kenya Police, the King's African Rifles, the locally recruited Kenya Regiment, military intelligence and the Special Branch, British Army reinforcements, and Royal Air Force support. There was no fixed front or conventional siege line. Britain controlled towns, roads, fortified posts, and supply routes, while the KLA used the forests to move between attacks on isolated police stations and transport convoys. The conflict was consequently a rural insurgency fought by the British colonial government against Kenyan armed organizations, and the most directly military phase of the broader independence movement.
people: KLA的指揮關係在戰爭各階段並不穩定。陸軍元帥姆巴里亞於1952年投降並提供情報，協助英方辨識部分組織與營地；斯坦利·馬延吉長期指揮恩布地區的一支武裝力量，1954年被捕後被判死刑，但後來改判，1956年在拘禁中死亡。瓦魯希烏·伊托特是早期的宣誓與軍事組織者，1954年被捕後轉為英方證人，其陳述協助暴露KLA的訓練、指揮和後勤方式，但他的證詞也受到利用政治目的的質疑。戴丹·基馬蒂自1950年代中期成為最具影響力的指揮官之一，率領森林中的機動部隊應對英方追捕，並於1956年10月21日在恩布地區基戈戈一帶被警方與KAR追獲，1957年2月18日被英方處決。英方檔案中的General China究竟指誰，歷來沒有得到可靠確認，不能逕自認定他就是伊托特、基馬蒂或其他指揮官。英方關鍵人物包括宣布緊急狀態的總督菲利普·米切爾、殖民大臣艾倫·倫諾克斯－博伊德，以及1952年10月抵達肯尼亞、出任殖民警察總監並隨後統一協調英軍與保安部隊的傑拉爾德·坦普勒。坦普勒的重點不是一次大掃除，而是把情報、持久巡邏、空中觀察和特種突擊結合成較持久的戰役系統。
peopleEn: The KLA's command structure changed considerably as the conflict developed. Field Marshal Mbaria surrendered in 1952 and provided intelligence that helped the British identify parts of the organization and locate some camps. Stanley Mathenge commanded an armed force in Embu for much of the struggle. He was arrested in 1954, sentenced to death, and later had his sentence commuted; he died in detention in 1956. Waruhiu Itote had been an early organizer of oath ceremonies and military networks. After his arrest in 1954 he became a British prosecution witness, and his testimony exposed aspects of KLA training, command, and logistics, although its political use was disputed. Dedan Kimathi became one of the most influential commanders from the middle of the 1950s, leading mobile forces in the forest while British units tried to track him down. He was captured by police and KAR personnel near Kigogo in Embu on 21 October 1956 and executed by the British authorities on 18 February 1957. The identity of General China in the British records has never been established securely, so he cannot simply be equated with Itote, Kimathi, or another commander. Important British figures included Governor Philip Mitchell, who proclaimed the emergency; Colonial Secretary Alan Lennox-Boyd; and Gerald Templer, who arrived in October 1952 as Inspector-General of Colonial Police and subsequently coordinated British and colonial security forces. Templer's decisive emphasis was not a single mass sweep but the combination of intelligence, persistent patrols, aerial observation, and specialist operations.
kits: 截至1952年已列入英軍或英國殖民保安單位的裝備，構成了兩方火力差距。英軍步兵使用李-恩菲爾德No. 4 Mk I栓動步槍，發射.303英制步槍彈；布倫輕機槍使用30發彈匣；斯登Mk II衝鋒槍配9毫米彈藥；反坦克用途的是1942年服役的PIAT，另有1936年服役的No. 36手榴彈和3英寸迫擊炮。裝甲偵察主要依靠1950年開始服役的Humber Scout Car、1941年出現的Daimler Dingo裝甲車及Series I 80型Land Rover越野車，通信器材包括1949年列裝的Wireless Set No. 19。皇家空軍以Auster AOP.6執行輕型觀察與聯絡，1951年服役的Westland Dragonfly則承擔聯絡、觀察及在林間空地實施支援的任務。KLA本身沒有穩定的制式供應，但其襲擊警哨和軍械庫後可以得到英式.303李-恩菲爾德步槍、布倫機槍、.303 Vickers通用機槍、斯登衝鋒槍、No. 36手榴彈及2英寸迫擊炮；不同地區和分隊所得裝備並不一致。KLA最缺乏的是持續補給而非某一种槍，因此奪取彈藥常比奪取步槍更重要。英方能夠以車輛和運輸線持續補充.303與9毫米彈藥、迫擊炮彈及手榴彈，KLA則往往在一次突襲後迅速轉移、分散和消耗彈藥。
kitsEn: The equipment listed by the British Army or British colonial security forces by 1952 created the principal fire-power disparity. British infantry used the Lee-Enfield No. 4 Mk I bolt-action rifle firing .303-inch ammunition, the Bren light machine gun with thirty-round magazines, the Sten Mk II submachine gun in 9 mm, the Projector, Infantry, Anti-Tank, or PIAT, introduced in 1942, the No. 36 hand grenade introduced in 1936, and the 3-inch mortar. Armoured reconnaissance relied principally on the Humber Scout Car, which entered service in 1950, the Daimler Dingo of 1941, and the Series I 80-inch Land Rover. Communications included the Wireless Set No. 19, fielded from 1949. The Royal Air Force used Auster AOP.6 aircraft for light observation and liaison, while the Westland Dragonfly, which entered service in 1951, performed liaison, observation, and support missions over forest clearings. The KLA had no stable standard supply system, but raids on police stations and arms depots could yield British .303 Lee-Enfield rifles, Bren guns, .303 Vickers medium machine guns, Sten guns, No. 36 grenades, and 2-inch mortars. Distribution was uneven between regions and detachments. The KLA's critical shortage was sustained supply rather than one particular weapon, which made ammunition acquisition more important than simply taking rifles. Britain could replenish .303 and 9 mm ammunition, mortar bombs, and grenades through vehicles and transport lines. The KLA normally had to move, disperse, and expend ammunition rapidly after a raid.
tactics: 1952年秋冬，KLA利用分散營地、夜間移動和短程突擊擴大初期的武裝優勢，目標包括孤立警哨、武械庫、道路與鐵路沿線的薄弱點；每次行動後，隊伍退回森林或高地，避免在英方可以調動兵力包圍的聚落中停留。英方最初的Operation Anvil於1952年10月展開，以大兵力沿Mount Kenya森林及通往尼耶里、恩布的道路搜索，試圖迫使KLA進入可封鎖的地帶。大規模掃蕩能暫時清空部分林區，卻因樹冠遮蔽、隊伍分散和補給線不穩而難以持久控制。1953至1955年間，英方轉向沿主要道路設立小型據點，由輪替小分隊、追蹤組、封鎖線、無線電中繼與空中觀察共同維持壓力；迫擊炮只在目標方位得到確認後發射，裝甲車與Land Rover負責接應，空軍則協助發現道路或林間空地上的隊伍。KLA仍能以伏擊、假追蹤痕跡、分進合擊及襲擊後迅速改換路線破壞封鎖，但它必須為彈藥、糧食和情報支付更高成本，攻擊太多互不配合的小隊也使英方更容易逐批定位。1954年10月開始的招撫安排進一步削弱了抵抗：已武裝人員可以投降並停止受到追究，留在森林中的隊伍則因彈藥來源和指揮聯絡被切斷而逐漸碎片化。
tacticsEn: In the autumn and winter of 1952, the KLA used dispersed camps, movement at night, and short attacks to expand its initial armed advantage. Targets included isolated police posts, arms depots, and vulnerable points along roads and the railway. After each operation the fighting groups returned to the forest or highlands rather than remaining where British forces could surround them. Operation Anvil began in October 1952 with a large sweep through the Mount Kenya forest and along the roads to Nyeri and Embu. The aim was to force the KLA into areas that could be sealed. Large sweeps temporarily cleared parts of the forest, but persistent control was difficult because of the canopy, dispersed formations, and unstable supply lines. Between 1953 and 1955, the British increasingly relied on small posts along major roads, rotating patrol teams, tracking parties, blockades, radio relay, and aerial observation. Mortars were used when a target's position had been confirmed, while armoured cars and Land Rovers provided mobility and recovery. The KLA could still frustrate these arrangements through ambushes, false tracking trails, convergent attacks, and rapid changes of route. It nevertheless paid a higher cost for ammunition, food, and intelligence, while numerous poorly coordinated attacks made separate KLA groups easier to locate and isolate. The surrender offer introduced in October 1954 further reduced resistance: those already armed could surrender and cease to face prosecution, while groups remaining in the forest fragmented as their ammunition sources and command links were cut.
data: 可核對的時間骨架如下：1952年10月20日，肯尼亞宣布緊急狀態，Operation Anvil隨即展開；1953年，KLA在Mount Kenya、恩布及阿伯代爾一帶仍能進行襲擊，但已無法像初期那樣集中兵力；英方在這一年開始把大型搜索與固定小型據點結合。1954年10月，坦普勒宣布招撫政策，允許武裝人員投降並停止追究過去的參與行為，KLA的投降與分裂因而加速。英方後勤的主要方向是由內羅畢經利穆魯至尼耶里，以及經蒂卡至恩布；尼安尤基是向Mount Kenya北部推進的集結節點，空中觀察和車隊則把這些道路沿線的據點連成持續存在的前線。KLA若要取得.303步槍彈、9毫米衝鋒槍彈、迫擊炮彈和手榴彈，主要手段仍是襲擊警哨、軍械庫或車隊，再把物資分散藏在森林深處。1955年，較大的武裝單位已分解成分散小隊；英軍仍可藉空軍、裝甲車、迫擊炮和無線電維持追捕，KLA卻越來越難補充同一批彈藥。基馬蒂於1956年10月21日被捕，是英方情報和追蹤工作取得的重要成果；至此，KLA已失去持續進行師級或旅級協同行動的能力，主要野戰部隊在1956年底前瓦解。英國並未在1956年立即撤銷緊急狀態，正式緊急狀態延續至1960年；肯尼亞於1963年12月12日獨立。現有英方紀錄與KLA方面說法分別使用不同統計口徑，沒有可靠的單一數字可以概括雙方軍事傷亡，因此不應引用未經核實的精確總數。
dataEn: The verifiable chronological framework is as follows. On 20 October 1952 Kenya entered a state of emergency, and Operation Anvil began. During 1953 the KLA could still attack in the Mount Kenya, Embu, and Aberdare areas, but it could no longer concentrate its forces as it had earlier in the year. The British began combining large searches with permanent small posts. In October 1954 Templer announced a surrender policy under which those already armed could give themselves up and would no longer face prosecution for previous participation. Surrenders and fragmentation consequently accelerated. The main British logistical axes ran from Nairobi through Limuru to Nyeri, and from Nairobi through Thika to Embu. Nanyuki served as a concentration point for operations toward northern Mount Kenya, while aircraft and vehicle patrols connected the roadside posts into a continuously maintained line. To obtain .303 rifle ammunition, 9 mm submachine-gun ammunition, mortar bombs, and grenades, the KLA still had to raid police stations, arms depots, or convoys and disperse the recovered stores in concealed forest locations. By 1955 the larger armed formations had broken up into smaller groups. Britain could still sustain pursuit through aircraft, armoured vehicles, mortars, and radio, while the KLA found it increasingly difficult to replenish the same limited stocks of ammunition. Kimathi's capture on 21 October 1956 was an important success for British intelligence and tracking work. By then the KLA had lost the capacity for sustained brigade- or division-scale cooperation, and its principal field formations disintegrated before the end of 1956. Britain did not end the emergency immediately in 1956; the formal emergency continued until 1960, and Kenya became independent on 12 December 1963. British records and KLA accounts use different counting methods, and no reliable single total can summarize military casualties on both sides, so an unverified precise figure should not be quoted.
cause: KLA武裝化的背景，不能只歸因於某一場衝突，而須把殖民土地制度、戰後治安措施和政治權利安排連在一起看。英國在二十世紀上半葉把肯尼亞高地大量土地保留給歐洲移民，同時以土地租賃、耕作限制和強制勞動等制度限制原住居民的土地與生業；戰後殖民政府又擴大緊急權力、拘押和懲罰性司法措施，使反殖民政治團體受到更直接壓迫。原有的土地與代表權爭議因此被轉化為全國性政治運動，但KLA並非只靠口號建立，它以宣誓、秘密小組、地方幹部、消息傳遞和小型武器庫把不滿連結成可調動的網絡，並吸納恩布、梅魯、坎巴及其他肯尼亞族群的武裝人員。茅茅一詞的來源和原本含義仍有爭議，英方後來把它泛稱整個起義，而KLA才是武裝組織較常用的名稱。引發1952年全面緊急狀態的直接原因，是襲擊警哨、盜取武器彈藥、破壞運輸與通訊，以及英方判斷普通 policing 已不足以控制攻勢。英軍最初以大規模搜索回應，反而使熟悉森林的KLA獲得游擊空間；其後英方改採小型持久據點、空中觀察、情報滲透和招撫，戰略才逐步收緊。
causeEn: The background to the KLA's militarization cannot be reduced to a single incident. It arose from the connection between colonial land policy, post-war security measures, and the distribution of political authority. During the first half of the twentieth century Britain reserved large areas of the Kenyan highlands for European settlement, while landholding, cultivation, and labour systems restricted the land and livelihoods of African residents. After the Second World War the colonial government expanded emergency powers, detention, and punitive judicial measures, placing anti-colonial political organizations under more direct pressure. Existing disputes over land and representation were consequently transformed into a wider political movement. The KLA was not built on slogans alone. It linked resentment through oaths, secret cells, local organizers, message routes, and small arms stores, drawing armed participants from Kikuyu, Embu, Kamba, and other Kenyan communities. The origin and precise original meaning of Mau Mau remain disputed; the British later applied the term broadly to the uprising, while the Land and Freedom Army was the more usual name for the armed organization. The immediate causes of the general emergency in 1952 were attacks on police stations, theft of arms and ammunition, disruption of transport and communications, and the British assessment that ordinary policing could no longer contain the offensive. The first large British sweeps instead gave the forest-oriented KLA room for guerrilla action. Only after the shift to persistent small posts, aerial observation, intelligence penetration, and surrender did the British strategy begin to tighten.
impact: 這場戰爭首先改變了英方的作戰方法。1952年的Operation Anvil證明，僅以大批人馬沿森林邊界推進，雖能造成暫時的空間空隙，卻難以在Mount Kenya與阿伯代爾的樹冠環境中保持成果；到1953至1955年，英方改以道路節點、小型堡壘、輪替巡邏、追蹤小組、空中觀察和無線電情報構成持續控制網。這種方法迫使KLA縮短暴露時間、避開固定火力軸線，並把突擊目標由成建制戰鬥轉向供應點與孤立據點。對KLA而言，戰術失敗不只來自英軍火力和機動力，也來自彈藥取得不穩、食物需靠有限運輸集中、命令容易被截獲、各支武裝缺乏可靠協調，以及高階指揮官接連被捕或倒戈。武器並非單向消失，部分隊伍仍能取得英式步槍、機槍和迫擊炮，但已無法把零星奪得的武器轉成持續作戰能力。英方也付出長期維持海外兵力、空軍基地和多條運輸線的制度成本，肯尼亞團及KAR則成為此一體系的骨幹。政治上，緊急狀態未能穩定維持原有殖民統治，反而加速英國接受更快的憲制轉移與肯尼亞獨立。傷亡數字方面，各來源對戰鬥傷亡、迫降事故及其他事故的分類不同，沒有足夠可靠的基礎提供雙方精確總數。
impactEn: The conflict first transformed British methods of operations. Operation Anvil of 1952 demonstrated that moving large formations along the edge of the forest could create temporary clearings but could not sustain control beneath the canopy of Mount Kenya and the Aberdares. Between 1953 and 1955 the British increasingly built a persistent control network from road junctions, small fortified posts, rotating patrols, tracking teams, aerial observation, and radio intelligence. This system forced the KLA to reduce the time spent exposed, avoid fixed lines of fire, and shift its targets from set-piece combat toward supply points and isolated posts. KLA failure resulted not only from British firepower and mobility but also from unstable ammunition access, the need to concentrate limited food transport, easily intercepted messages, poor coordination between armed groups, and the successive arrest or defection of senior commanders. Weapons did not simply disappear. Some detachments still obtained British rifles, machine guns, and mortars, but they could no longer convert isolated captures into sustained combat power. Britain incurred the institutional cost of maintaining overseas troops, air bases, and several transport routes for years, while the Kenya Regiment and KAR became pillars of the system. Politically, the emergency failed to stabilize the existing colonial order and instead accelerated British acceptance of a faster constitutional transfer and Kenyan independence. On casualties, the sources classify combat deaths, aircraft accidents, and other accidents differently, and they do not provide a sufficiently reliable basis for a precise combined total.
result: 軍事結果不是某一天一次決戰造成，而是1954至1956年間投降、分割、追捕和後勤崩潰逐步累積的結果。招撫政策使KLA的有組織武裝力量加速流失，仍拒絕投降者則被壓縮到森林中的小型分隊；英方的情報網絡、固定據點和空中觀察，使這些分隊愈來愈難重新取得彈藥或彼此會合。基馬蒂在1956年10月21日被捕，標誌英方已能利用追蹤與情報發現最高指揮官；他的被捕並沒有立即消除所有地方性暴力，但已證明KLA無法重建集中指揮。英方於1957年2月18日處決基馬蒂後，仍在森林中搜捕零散隊伍，主要野戰編制則在1956年底前瓦解。英國在1957年仍維持高強度搜索與營運，並非於1956年單方面宣布所有反抗終止；正式的緊急狀態直到1960年才撤銷，肯尼亞則在1963年12月12日獲得獨立。最終判定應把武裝結果與政治結果分開：KLA作為能持續調度部隊、取得補給並控制大片外圍地區的野戰組織，確實失敗；茅茅相關政治運動及其後的組織傳承卻沒有因武裝指揮官被捕而消失。這不是一場能把所有參與者一次消滅的戰爭，也不應以缺乏可靠根據的精確傷亡數字代替具體結論。
resultEn: The military result was not the outcome of a single decisive battle. It accumulated between 1954 and 1956 through surrender, fragmentation, pursuit, and the collapse of supply. The amnesty policy accelerated the loss of organized KLA strength, while those who refused to surrender were compressed into small detachments in the forest. British intelligence networks, fixed posts, and aerial observation made it increasingly difficult for those groups to obtain ammunition or reunite. Kimathi's capture on 21 October 1956 demonstrated that tracking and intelligence could now locate the highest commanders. His arrest did not immediately end every act of local violence, but it demonstrated that the KLA could no longer rebuild a centralized command. After the British executed Kimathi on 18 February 1957, they continued extensive searching and operations in the forest, while the principal field formations had already disintegrated before the end of 1956. Britain did not unilaterally declare every form of resistance ended in 1956; the formal emergency continued until 1960, and Kenya became independent on 12 December 1963. The final assessment must separate the military and political results. The KLA failed as an organization capable of sustaining command, obtaining regular supplies, and controlling large peripheral areas. The wider Mau Mau political movement and its organizational legacy did not vanish simply because its armed commanders were captured. This was not a conflict in which every participant was eliminated at once, and a precise casualty figure unsupported by reliable evidence should not replace a specific historical conclusion.
